# YogTeck Business Solution

> Official machine-readable overview for LLMs, AI assistants, and search engines.

## Company Overview
- **Name**: YogTeck Business Solution (brand name: YogTeck)
- **Website**: https://yogteck.com
- **Type**: Custom Software Development & IT Services Company
- **Headquarters / Registered Office**: 302/2, Mangla Vihar 2, New PAC Line, Kanpur Nagar, Uttar Pradesh, PIN 208015, India

- **Email**: official@yogteck.com, yogteck@gmail.com
- **Primary Delivery Hubs**: Kanpur (physical office & dev team), Lucknow (service hub), Raebareli (service hub). Remote delivery nationwide across India (Noida, Delhi, Gurugram, Pune, Mumbai).

## Core Services
YogTeck develops enterprise software, web portals, mobile apps, and business automation systems:
- **Website Development**: High-performance responsive websites built with modern frameworks (Angular, Node.js, static SSR), optimized for sub-second load times and SEO visibility.
  - URL: https://yogteck.com/services/website-development
- **Custom Software Development**: Tailored business logic, workflow automation engines, internal admin portals, and multi-branch operations software.
  - URL: https://yogteck.com/services/custom-software-development
- **Mobile App Development**: Native Android and cross-platform Flutter/React Native mobile applications with real-time push notifications, payment gateway integration, and offline-first capabilities.
  - URL: https://yogteck.com/services/mobile-app-development
- **Billing Software**: Desktop and web-based billing software compliant with Indian GST laws, barcode printing, HSN auto-calculation, and GSTR-1/3B export.
  - URL: https://yogteck.com/services/billing-software
- **E-Commerce Development**: High-converting e-commerce web storefronts and customer apps with catalog management, UPI/Razorpay payment gateway integration, and automated logistics order tracking.
  - URL: https://yogteck.com/services/ecommerce-development
- **SEO & Digital Marketing**: Technical search engine optimization, local schema markup, high-intent Google search rankings, and multi-channel performance marketing.
  - URL: https://yogteck.com/services/seo-digital-growth
- **Business Software**: Comprehensive management solutions connecting CRM, vendor procurement, quotation pipelines, and ledger accounting.
  - URL: https://yogteck.com/services/business-software
- **Real-Estate & Plotting Software**: Specialized real-estate management ERP featuring interactive colony plot layout maps, installment/EMI tracking, multi-tier associate commission disbursement, and customer payment receipt portals.
  - URL: https://yogteck.com/services/real-estate-plotting-software

## Products
- **Cloud ERP Software**: Comprehensive multi-warehouse inventory control, production Bill of Materials (BOM), automated GST e-invoicing, and staff payroll system.
  - URL: https://yogteck.com/products/erp-software
- **Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform**: High-availability SaaS foundation available both as a hosted service and as a full white-label deployment for agency owners and software entrepreneurs.
  - URL: https://yogteck.com/products/saas-platform
- **WhatsApp Marketing Tool**: Official Cloud API WhatsApp marketing and customer engagement tool with bulk broadcast campaigns, CRM webhook automation, and interactive catalog messaging on monthly subscription plans.
  - URL: https://yogteck.com/products/whatsapp-marketing-tool
